assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two REVIEWED items on the subject's row at basis_commit, both canonical: CPK_F01_INTEGRATED_SYNTHESIS.md v1.1 (Iroha in §§2.3, 3, 4.3, 5, 6 and 7, with rival readings §8 and open questions §9) and CPK_CHARACTER_RELATIONSHIP_LEDGER.md v1.3 (current §7 and the §6 gap assessment it supplements; historical §§1–5 rows only where §7 does not revise them). Both analyze the single admitted Japanese witness of F01 (00:00:00.000–02:22:03.207) through the reconciled CPK-R1, CPK-B1-SOL61 and CPK-AVRET-R1 passes with owner audiovisual adjudication. The draft_noncurrent primary reading, the independent bundle monograph and the three #594 character monographs (draft_noncurrent, do_not_use_as_current_authority) are not evidence. SPEECH means Japanese dialogue and subtitle text as analyzed, not vocal performance. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: F01 presentation order, split at located state changes: the 2030 main story (official age 17; the flashback settlement with Momiji, cohabitation with Kaguya, fever before KASSEN at 00:48:30–00:51:40, KASSEN 00:56–01:11, the 01:32:54 summer-festival refusal, the 01:39:09 melody recognition, Kaguya's retrieval at 01:47:51); the post-loss sequence (01:51:39 post-play shatter, 01:52:48 phone permission, 01:53:04 completion of Reply, 02:02:43–02:06:50 memory dive and mirror sea); and the 10年後 horizon (02:07:50–02:10:25, a few minutes of runtime; the 2040 year and age 27 are inferences). Memories of her father and of composing with him belong to her at every state.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A specialist account of her agency: the self-funding settlement and overexertion to fever, the negative-volitional refusal to repeat Momiji's exclusionary phrase (言いたくなかったの, K0006, E0003), delegation to Kaguya that defeats Asahi's prediction of solitary self-sacrifice (K0004), refusal of imposed closure (01:51:39), and the governing choice of particular love over a sufficiency she states is true (K0011, §7). It also predicts her overreach: the 問答無用 override of Yachiyo's memory privacy (E0007). Each decisive motive is sampled once and analyzed as theme, so the evidence does not say what decides between armoured self-reliance and delegation outside the trust built with Kaguya. The ledger's two policy labels (armoured perfectionism, integrated agency) are not elaborated.

Knowledge and motivational checkpoints are located by timestamp and mode (K0002, K0004–K0012), and the 2030 to post-loss to 10年後 changes are anchored at the phone permission, the completion of Reply and the mirror sea. The adult horizon is a few minutes of runtime with lab and household vignettes only, so the later state is labeled rather than modeled.

Verified lines with pragmatic notes (J0003 settlement explanation, J0005 negative volitional, J0006 one chorus and 同じメロ？, J0008 youth-colloquial ないっしょ！ and the muted plea, J0010 the mirror-sea lines, J0011 the YC型 remark), but no Iroha register profile across interlocutors (Momiji, Roka and Mami, Asahi, Kaguya) and no account of her Kansai or standard usage. The project explicitly declines to give っしょ/じゃん exclusive speaker attributions.

Household economics are analyzed (living-cost split, repayment, chores, pancakes, being nursed through fever), and ledger §6 lists room routine, school and cohabitation scenes by scene ID. Routine conduct itself is not described as behavior, and her own everyday care of others beyond the infant lullaby is not analyzed.

Directed edges give her conduct toward Kaguya at 2030 and adult horizons (E0003, E0010), toward Yachiyo via FUSHI (E0007, E0008) and toward Momiji (settlement, refusal to replicate, the phone plea), with Asahi's and the friends' edges toward her (E0004, E0005). Her own behavior toward Roka, Mami and Asahi is barely analyzed.

Located interior states: remembering composing with her father without yet recognizing the melody (K0005), consciously choosing silence over dismissal (K0006), knowing she has grown enough yet wanting to stay with Kaguya (K0011), twelve seconds of wordless weeping read as the collapse of sufficiency. The film withholds the wording of her phone plea (U0009), and the evidence preserves that gap.

Located instances: tactical delegation under sibling pressure in KASSEN, smashing the post-play screen and reclaiming her career survey (もうちょい迷います！), pressing FUSHI past refusal and a bodily-risk warning, negotiated rather than confrontational family conflict ending in permission. Open confrontation with Momiji is not shown.

Two located ethical positions are analyzed with their tension kept: refusing to inflict an exclusionary boundary she suffered, and overriding a privacy boundary Yachiyo never waives to rescue her (ledger E0007; synthesis §8 rival reading 3). No deliberation is shown before the override, so the evidence describes positions and costs, not a procedure.
Local items only: the comic 蛇足ぅ～！ (JA#2714), the youth-colloquial ないっしょ！ at the shatter, and the provisional openness the synthesis reads in the coda. No account of her playfulness.

The film is covered end to end by an audited, cue-anchored corpus with owner adjudication, and the key Iroha scenes are located. The analysis of her is distributed across a film synthesis and a multi-subject ledger rather than a subject-centered study; the ledger records operational reconstruction as NOT_ATTEMPTED, and ordinary scenes are listed rather than read.

Affirmative limits and counterevidence: overexertion to fever, Asahi's failed prediction as evidence against a solitary self-sacrifice model, the constraint against collapsing her pre-call agency into passive compliance (§7.5.1), and the ethical edge of the privacy override. Ages 7 and 27, the 2040 calendar year and consciousness mechanics are affirmatively not character knowledge (§7.5.3).

States are keyed to presentation time, disclosure horizon and SCENE_BOUND versus RETROSPECTIVE_F01 mode; official age 17 is separated from inferred ages and calendar dates; earlier chronology errors are repaired at located timestamps (fever before KASSEN, sibling recognition at 00:58:53, recognition at 01:39:09.61).

scenario_readiness.note: About ten attested lines with pragmatic notes do not constrain new Japanese output to her voice across interlocutors; the evidence analyzes subtitle text, not delivery. This limits use and is not by itself a tier criterion.

conditions: The scenario poses one of the located choice structures: material self-reliance against accepting help, repeating or refusing a dismissal she received, accepting or refusing an imposed ending, or pressing past a gatekeeper to reach someone she loves.

The state is named (2030 before or after the 01:52:48 phone permission, or post-loss) and the counterpart is Kaguya, Yachiyo or a Momiji-like family authority; transfer to another partner is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
Self-reliance versus delegation with anyone other than Kaguya, and the adult 10年後 state, end in an open fork rather than a prediction.
Output is behavioral description with its ethical cost stated, not quotation.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A named F01 state: 2030 main story before or after the phone permission, or the post-loss sequence; not the 10年後 horizon.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kaguya as cohabiting partner, Yachiyo as older Kaguya, or Momiji as family authority; others only as a lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: Near-future Tokyo household, school or Tsukuyomi setting comparable to F01
A concrete choice between self-reliance, delegation, closure or intrusion
No assumption about consciousness mechanics or post-2040 society

scenario_readiness.note: The located choices transfer narrowly to comparable choices; broad novel-context simulation is not supported.
Ordinary school, friend and household scenes are listed by ID rather than analyzed as behavior.

conditions: The dilemma closely matches a located position: inflicting an exclusionary boundary, or overriding another's privacy to rescue a loved one.
Output keeps the ethical tension the evidence preserves and predicts the override as overreach, not as justified by default.
No general ethical procedure is attributed to her.
scenario_readiness.note: Two positions with stated costs are supported; deliberation steps are not shown.
The evidence analyzes her bond with Kaguya as particular love and attachment without classifying it as romance; nothing is graded from silence.

conditions: 2030 producer, composer or KASSEN role with Kaguya: delegation once trust exists, a one-chorus cap under deadline, self-funded labor at bodily cost.
The 10年後 laboratory role is not modeled beyond collaborative work and accepted rest (休むも仕事).
scenario_readiness.note: Located work decisions support bounded predictions inside the 2030 creator and combat contexts.

known_limits.statement: The project records operational reconstruction as NOT_ATTEMPTED and offers only constraint notes for a future model; this assessment grades the literary analysis, not a model.
The wording of her sunset phone plea is withheld by the film (U0009); her decisive family speech act cannot be reconstructed.
The 10年後 horizon is a few minutes of runtime plus silent vignettes; the 2040 year and age 27 are inferences and not character knowledge.
Consciousness and identity mechanics behind Kaguya and Yachiyo's co-presence are OPEN (U0001), so her adult relationships with them cannot be modeled as one or two persons.
The synthesis keeps live readings that place her resolution in creative emancipation rather than particular love, and that read the memory dive as an ethical violation.

No current subject-centered study is on the row; the #594 Iroha monograph is draft_noncurrent and was not used. Everyday conduct and relationships outside Kaguya, Yachiyo and Momiji are unanalyzed. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
